title: pogostemon sampsonii
intro: Pogostemon sampsonii, commonly known as Patchouli, is a type of herbaceous plant native to Southeast Asia and Australia. The health benefits of Patchouli include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations, reduce stress, and protect against environmental pollutants. The therapeutic actions of Patchouli include its ability to calm the mind and body, reduce anxiety and depression, and promote a good night's sleep. The bioactive constituents of Patchouli include patchoulol, pogostone, and norpatchoulenone, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects and are often used in aromatherapy and traditional medicine.
